Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent mascot, IDLE / WAITING state in a five-state web application set.
Edit the single supplied cartoon reference. It is the only visual reference: an original fictional technology gatekeeper. Keep the SAME character, high broad forehead, chestnut swept-back hair in bold simple shapes, long tapered face and rounded chin, short blunt nose, slim black rectangular glasses, thick expressive eyebrows, warm peach skin, American-flag patterned navy/red/white suit, white shirt and red tie. Preserve the SAME smooth bold outlines and polished 2D cel shading. No photographic texture.
Change only the pose and expression: he is bored and dozing while waiting to inspect the next visitor. Eyes gently closed behind his rectangular glasses, brows relaxed, tiny slack sleepy mouth. Head tilted with one cheek resting on his hand. The other hand loosely holds the small red rubber stamp down near his waist, its symbol hidden. Funny laziness, aesthetically appealing and dryly satirical. Keep his face shape, forehead, glasses, hair silhouette and clothing recognizable and consistent.
Composition: single centered waist-up character with large head, full hair and both hands inside the canvas with clear margins, the same compact upper-body scale as the reference; natural curved bottom cutout at jacket waist. Genuine transparent background. No letters or Z symbols, no speech balloons, no extra icons, no desk, no scene, no ground shadow, no text, no watermark. One character, no sheet of variants.

No scene, no desk, no extra floating icons, no writing, no speech balloons, no watermark, no background or floor shadow. Readable when reduced to 230px tall. One character only.

Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: wordless square avatar logo accompanying a cartoon web-app mascot.
Use the supplied original fictional cartoon character as the ONLY reference. Create an iconic, simplified HEAD-AND-COLLAR portrait of this SAME invented gatekeeper for a small application logo. Preserve the characteristic high broad forehead, backward swept chestnut hair with three or four bold tufts, long tapered face and rounded chin, slim BLACK RECTANGULAR GLASSES, one sharply raised eyebrow, half-lidded eyes and small crooked knowing smile. Strong clean dark outlines, warm peach skin, only 2 or 3 flat shades, polished graphic 2D cartoon. No hands, no stamp, no stars, no stripes, no props. A single simple deep navy circular badge behind the head, slightly smaller than the full head silhouette so the upper swept hair breaks the top of the circle. Keep the whole badge and character entirely inside the canvas with 7% transparent margin. True transparent background OUTSIDE the badge and silhouette.
The style should feel cheeky and satirical, crisp, memorable and cohesive with the supplied mascot. No name, no lettering, no wordmark, no watermark, no extra symbols, no drop shadow. One finished icon, not a sheet of variations.
